description_en: Queries the information about an online editing project
description_zh: 查询单个云剪辑工程的信息
name: GetEditingProject

parameters.help_en: The ID of the online editing project
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the request source. Valid values:

- OpenAPI (default): Timeline conversion is not performed.

- WebSDK: If you specify this value, the project timeline is automatically converted into the frontend style, and the materials in the timeline are associated with the project to enable preview by using frontend web SDKs
parameters.help_zh:
请求来源标识

-OpenAPI：默认，不会做timeline转换操作。

-WebSDK：若传入该字段，则会自动将工程timeline转换为前端风格，并将timleine中关联素材和工程绑定，供前端websdk预览
parameters.name: request_source

Project.description_en: The information about the online editing project

BusinessConfig.description_en: The business configuration of the project. This parameter can be ignored for general editing projects
BusinessConfig.description_zh: 工程业务配置，一般剪辑工程可忽略

BusinessStatus.description_en:
The business status of the project. This parameter can be ignored for general editing projects. Valid values:

Reserving

ReservationCanceled

BroadCasting

LoadingFailed

LiveFinished
BusinessStatus.description_zh:
工程业务状态，一般剪辑工程可忽略

预约中：Reserving

预约取消：ReservationCanceled

直播中：BroadCasting

加载失败：LoadingFailed

直播结束：LiveFinished

ClipsParam.description_en: The material parameter corresponding to the template, in the JSON format. If TemplateId is specified, ClipsParam must also be specified. For more information<props="china">, see Create and use a regular template (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/328557.html) and Create and use an advanced template (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/291418.html)</props>
ClipsParam.description_zh: 模板对应的素材参数，Json格式，当TemplateId不为空时，ClipsParam不能为空。具体格式见 [普通模板创建及使用]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445399.html）、[高级模板创建及使用]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445389.html）

CoverURL.description_en: The thumbnail URL of the online editing project

- AliyunConsole

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the online editing project was created

Description.description_en: The description of the online editing project

Duration.description_en: The total duration of the online editing project

ModifiedSource.description_en:
The method for editing the online editing project. Valid values:

- OpenAPI

- AliyunConsole

- WebSDK

- LiveEditingOpenAPI

- LiveEditingConsole

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the online editing project was last modified
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 云剪辑工程最新修改时间
ModifiedTime.title_en: 云剪辑工程最新修改时间
ModifiedTime.title_zh: 云剪辑工程最新修改时间

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the online editing project

ProjectType.description_en:
The type of the editing project. Default value: EditingProject. Valid values:

- EditingProject: a regular editing project.

- LiveEditingProject: a live stream editing project
ProjectType.description_zh:
剪辑工程类型，默认EditingProject

- EditingProject: 普通剪辑工程

- LiveEditingProject: 直播剪辑工程

Status.description_en:
The status of the online editing project. Valid values:

- Draft

- Editing

- Producing

- Produced

- ProduceFailed

- Deleted
Status.description_zh:
云剪辑工程状态。
所有云剪辑工程状态列表：

-Draft

-Editing

-Producing

-Produced

-ProduceFailed

-Deleted

TemplateType.description_en:
The template type of the online editing project. Valid values:

- Timeline

- VETemplate

Timeline.description_en: The timeline of the online editing project

TimelineConvertErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the project conversion failed. The error message displays the detailed information about the failure, and is returned only if the value of TimelineConvertStatus is ConvertFailed
TimelineConvertErrorMessage.description_zh: 工程转换失败信息，只有TimelineConvertStatus为ConvertFailed时返回，工程转换的详细失败信息
TimelineConvertErrorMessage.example: The StorageLocation must be in the same division(apiRegion) as ICE service access point.

TimelineConvertStatus.description_en:
The project conversion status. Conversion of an API-style timeline into a frontend-style timeline is an asynchronous process and takes effect only if RequestSource:WebSDK is specified.

- Unconverted

- Converting

- Converted

- ConvertFailed
TimelineConvertStatus.description_zh:
工程转换状态，api风格timeline转换为前端风格timeline是一个异步过程，只有在设置RequestSource:WebSDK时生效。

-Unconverted：未进行Timeline转换

-Converting：工程正在转换中

-Converted：工程转换完成

-ConvertFailed：工程转换失败

Title.description_en: The title of the online editing project
